name: architecture-council
displayName: Architecture Council — Hard Technical Decision Room
description: Convene a senior technical architecture council to run a multi-round, consensus-driven brainstorming session for any hard engineering or architecture decision (system topology, network/transport protocol, data model & consistency, API/contract design, auth & trust boundaries, build-vs-buy, framework/runtime choice, performance/scaling, migration strategy). The Chief Architect always chairs; specialists (software, systems, network, applications, security architects + staff engineer + spec engineer) ground in the existing ADRs/code/live system, research PRIMARY sources (never training memory), validate empirically, stress-test each option against eight lenses, and converge to 1-3 (max 5) options with a ranked recommendation, an ADR-ready decision, and an executable spec for the chosen one. Invoke for every weighty or non-obvious technical decision.
author: RiseGen AI

usage.aiAssistants: MANDATORY to invoke before making or evaluating any hard or hard-to-reverse technical/architecture decision, or one with non-obvious trade-offs; read SKILL.md, then run the phased session (ground -> primary-source research + empirical validation -> consensus rounds -> 1-5 options + ranked recommendation + ADR-ready decision + executable spec).
usage.engineers: The council roster, the session protocol, and the decision deliverable format.
usage.founders: A repeatable, senior decision room for important, hard-to-reverse technical decisions.
